provenance.note: Observed rendered cadence and input-intent persistence. The in-tolerance-to-neutral interval is not a raw CDP transport latency measurement.

coarse_quantization_failures.note: Actual native command and POST_RENDER records. Command durations include dispatch/acknowledgement and are not exact held-input duration. Chord timing is a separate explicitly hypothetical replay; these runs used cardinal pulses only.
